name: breeze-tts-demo
description: A local demo of Breeze-TTS-2: GPU inference on Modal, a credential-holding local gateway, and a browser UI that plays PCM as it arrives.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix ui install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix gateway run setup --
scripts.start: npm --prefix ui run build && npm --prefix gateway start
scripts.deploy:hosted: npm run build && modal deploy infra/hosting.py
scripts.test: npm --prefix gateway test && npm --prefix ui test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:python
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix gateway run typecheck && npm --prefix ui run typecheck
